title: Joint blood pressure and cholesterol: no established incremental angiographic prediction across two centers
abstract: In Cleveland-to-Hungary angiography-cohort transport (303 training,270 evaluation records), adding a source-centered resting blood-pressure by total-cholesterol product changed Brier error by -0.000573 (joint bootstrap95% interval [-0.009575,0.010422]); incremental benefit was not established.
